Hey. Just finished my undergrad in chemistry here. Done a ton of lab work. Let me give you some solid advice. Learn how to use excel to prep all your lab notebook stuff and check the MSDS for dangerous chemicals used in any procedure. This is especially important if your lab partner is Incompetent because their odds of spilling some on you or splashing shit everywhere when a water hose gets loose are high. Weigh your shit fast and weigh everything you can at once including glassware so you don't get caught in the bottleneck at the balances.

To that note check the procedure and see of you'll actually need to get your product off of filter paper if not preweigh the filter paper so you don't waste time scraping your product off just subtract the weight of the paper and weigh the whole mess including the hirsch/buchner funnel if you want.

Bring a lab towell+ your own sponge for wiping shit up and cleaning. Buy a set of your own pipe cleaners for washing test tube and small things out and buy your own small rubber "policeman" spatula. 20$ on amazon will save you hours of fucking around in labs.
